title: After 15-year wait, Railway Board finally approves merger of MRTS with Chennai Metro Rail
summary: During the transition period of two years, the entire train operations would be handed over to the CMRL. The merger of the MRTS was initiated through a proposal dated January 27, 2011 sent by Tamil Nadu government.

title: TechnoSport to invest ₹130 crore to expand Erode manufacturing facility, to add 500 jobs
summary: TechnoSport will invest ₹130 crore to expand its Erode manufacturing facility. This expansion will increase production capacity and create 500 new jobs in Tamil Nadu. The activewear company is also growing its retail presence significantly. TechnoSport plans to double its exclusive brand outlets by the end of FY27. This investment strengthens the company's manufacturing capabilities in the state.

title: The Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Bill-2026: Why India’s gain should not be Odisha’s loss
summary: A NITI Aayog assessment this February found that, under a net‑zero scenario, mineral demand will be 51% higher than under current policy. In other words, dependence deepens, not eases, precisely as India races to build EVs, batteries, defence platforms and renewable capacity.
